Demolition Booked Against a Date, Not Just a General Idea of Soon

c: Ajax moves on real deadlines, and demolition here gets treated the same way. Ahead of a home sale, it’s usually a tired deck or an old above ground pool that a realtor’s flagged as something buyers won’t love in photos, cleared before the listing goes live. Across Westney Heights, Hermitage and Nottingham, it’s a structure torn down before a family’s own move, so the new owners aren’t inheriting someone else’s project. In Audley’s newest streets, it’s a leftover structure on a recently purchased lot, cleared before landscaping or a build begins. And near Pickering Village and the lakefront, it’s older properties finally clearing a structure that’s outlived its use, timed around a family’s own schedule rather than ours. The 700+ five-star reviews behind Live Junk Free keep circling back to the same word: reliable — the structure was gone by the date it needed to be, every time.

items.q: Our realtor flagged our pool as something buyers won't love — can you help before listing photos?

items.q: We just bought a lot in Audley with an old structure on it — can that be cleared before our build starts?
